scenario: A stream emits output counts 12, 30, 30, reconnects, then final 40; the final SDK object is also imported.
mechanism: Cumulative snapshots and duplicate transport representations are mistaken for additive increments.
detection: Same account/provider attempt and meter scope; sequence/finality lineage; repeated payload hash.
response: Keep observations, accept one final 40 for this request and category, derive monotone deltas only within the known epoch; never add final object to its snapshots.
test_assertion: All replay orders and duplicate imports produce output total 40; incomplete interim view is marked provisional.
residual_limit: If attempt identity is missing, deduplication can remain ambiguous; do not merge distinct identical requests.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: A logical agent span contains two provider attempts after a timeout; SDK and gateway each emit usage while parent run emits their summary.
mechanism: Logical retry span and ancestor rollup overlap real charged attempts; deduplicating by logical span can also erase the second attempt.
detection: Attempt IDs, retry links, wrapper source lineage and rollup scope; reconciliation against biller usage.
response: Meter unique economic attempts once; attach summaries as derived assertions; retain error attempts with known usage.
test_assertion: Two attempts with 100 and 80 input tokens produce 180, irrespective of wrapper/parent copies; a timeout alone never forces zero.
residual_limit: Undisclosed upstream retries require authoritative provider/billing reconciliation.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: A resumed session emits 900, resets to 20 after restart, and then a late pre-restart 950 arrives.
mechanism: Arrival-order subtraction produces negative or inflated deltas; blindly treating every decrease as reset hides schema changes.
detection: Counter start/epoch, source sequence, process instance and event time; unresolved negative-difference alarms.
response: Partition by proven epochs, reorder within each, revise affected event-time aggregates; quarantine unexplained reset.
test_assertion: Known complete epochs yield 950 plus 20; replay order leaves totals identical. Unknown starting epoch leaves coverage incomplete.
residual_limit: Without true reset/start evidence, amount incurred during a gap is not identifiable.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: Exporter upgrade sends old cache_creation alias and new cache_write name together while a provider includes cache and reasoning inside totals.
mechanism: Alias duplication and addition of subsets overstates usage; absent fields during migration are misread as zero cache.
detection: Instrumentation/schema version, alias map, raw payload and inclusion constraints; compare dual-emitted values.
response: Versioned canonicalization maps equivalent aliases once and preserves raw evidence; conflicts quarantine; absence is unsupported/unknown unless zero is explicitly defined.
test_assertion: Input 1000/cache-read 700/cache-write 100 and output 200/reasoning 120 remain input 1000/output 200; duplicate aliases do not change them.
residual_limit: Provider-specific billing partition still needs verified semantics and tariff rules.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: Streaming generation produces partial usage, returns an error, and fallback model succeeds under the same logical operation; original final usage never arrives.
mechanism: Successful fallback hides first-attempt consumption, or a blanket per-field maximum merges two models.
detection: Per-attempt model/provider/status, missing terminal event, timeout watermark and later bill reconciliation.
response: Keep first attempt's known partial usage as incomplete; meter second attempt separately; mark residual unobserved usage and avoid a fabricated exact charge.
test_assertion: Successful fallback does not delete partial failed-attempt usage; finality is incomplete until reconciled; model-specific totals remain separate.
residual_limit: Unreported provider consumption may only be recoverable from coarser billing buckets.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: Two tenants reuse session ID 17; one human changes teams mid-period while a linked run completes after the move.
mechanism: Global ID collision merges records; present-day ownership reassigns historical usage or both parents claim a shared child.
detection: Tenant/source-qualified identifiers, effective-dated mapping version, causal links and attribution policy.
response: Separate source identities; apply declared effective-time ownership policy; assign shared/unresolved work once to shared/unassigned bucket.
test_assertion: No cross-tenant joins; company total invariant to team remap; as-of historical attribution remains reproducible.
residual_limit: Policy for team assignment of long runs is a business choice, not inferable from telemetry.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: Tail sampling retains expensive/error spans while unsampled usage counters continue; parser drops unknown schema partitions.
mechanism: Retained spans look like complete activity, and connector last-poll time masks missing partitions.
detection: Sampling policy/probability, expected/exported partitions, accepted/rejected row counts, request-to-counter reconciliation.
response: Do not extrapolate unknown selection probabilities; show separate collection/meter/attribution coverage; use trusted counter or charge view for totals.
test_assertion: Recent poll plus failed partitions does not set complete=true; selected trace sum is never labeled full spend.
residual_limit: Unknown sampling mechanisms prevent unbiased population recovery.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: A long session crosses local month end during DST while source timestamps have only seconds and delivery is next day.
mechanism: Ingest time or guessed timezone shifts usage between planning periods; coarse snapshots falsely imply exact per-period consumption.
detection: Source timezone/precision, event interval boundaries, ingestion time and counter scope.
response: Use explicit finance calendar and documented incurred-time rule; preserve interval-spanning ambiguity; keep late-arrival nowcast separate.
test_assertion: Reimport in another system timezone yields identical period membership; unknown timezone or spanning counter flags ambiguity rather than silently prorating.
residual_limit: Exact intra-interval consumption cannot be recovered from coarse cumulative snapshots.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: Provider corrects final tokens downward after the forecast cutoff, and an updated export replaces the earlier file.
mechanism: Overwrite makes a backtest use information not available originally; max-counter rules reject legitimate corrections.
detection: Source revision/content hash, first-seen time, supersession lineage and accepted basis.
response: Retain versions; use authority and revision ordering rather than maximum; query original information set for backtests and current accepted totals for dashboard.
test_assertion: Pre-correction as-of query returns old observation, post-correction returns revised total; replayed exports cannot add both versions.
residual_limit: Historical first-seen times cannot be reconstructed reliably from a final export alone.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection

scenario: Copilot continuation learner sees final result and full-session token totals; repeated SWE issue attempts split across train/test; BurstGPT no-failure variant is used as all-activity data.
mechanism: Future-label leakage, shared-task leakage and selection on success inflate apparent generalization.
detection: Feature availability audit, session/issue-group split audit, dataset variant/version and population manifest.
response: Generate prefix-only features; group session/issue families; preserve failure variant; scope claims to observed population and horizon.
test_assertion: Prediction-time features exclude future calls/results/final counts; no issue/session crosses folds; enterprise/month accuracy claim rejected for seven-day non-enterprise sample.
residual_limit: Even clean public tests cannot establish transfer to enterprise teams or prices.
requirement_source: docs/ai-spend-master-plan.md sections 2 and 4; docs/backend-plan.md acceptance checks; mentor-discussion.txt representativeness objection
